cohort: 60 primiparous women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage in Zahedan, Iran.
finding: Midwife-led brief counseling significantly reduced post-traumatic stress scores (PCL-5 and PPQ-II) in the intervention group compared to the control group.
followup_time: Approximately 6 weeks postpartum (4 weeks after the last intervention session which was 2 weeks postpartum)
